enonce_intro_markdown:
**SECTION D: ESSAY (10 marks)**

Choose one topic from those bellow and write an essay of between 150-180 words.

questions.enonce_markdown:
**Topic 1**

You have just obtained your BEPC examination and your parents who live in the village have chosen a wife/husband for you to get married to but you don't want him/her. Write a letter to them informing them why you think the marriage will not take place. You are Ngah Sylvie of P S S Kumba and your post office box number is 45. In this letter you should write about:

- Your age
- Your future,
- Your choice of a wife/husband.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Une lettre adressée à ses parents suit la structure classique de la lettre personnelle en anglais : l'adresse de l'expéditeur et la date en haut à droite, une formule d'appel adaptée au destinataire (« Dear Mum and Dad »), une introduction qui annonce l'objet de la lettre, un développement structuré selon les points imposés par le sujet, une formule de politesse finale, et la signature. Chaque point demandé dans la consigne (ici : ton âge, ton avenir, ton choix d'époux/épouse) doit apparaître clairement, si possible dans des paragraphes séparés.

### Corrigé détaillé
**Modèle de lettre (environ 165 mots) :**

P S S Kumba

P.O. Box 45

Kumba

12th June 2019

Dear Mum and Dad,

I hope this letter meets you in good health. I am writing to tell you why I cannot accept the marriage you have arranged for me.

First of all, I am only sixteen years old, which is far too young to start a married life. I still need to grow and mature before taking on such a big responsibility.

Secondly, I have just obtained my BEPC and I want to continue my studies so as to build a solid future for myself. Getting married now would put an end to my education and my dreams of becoming a nurse.

Finally, I believe that the choice of a husband is a personal decision. I would like to choose my own partner later, when I am ready and when I have finished my studies.

I hope you will understand my point of view and reconsider your decision.

Your loving daughter,

Sylvie

### Piège à éviter
Ne rédige jamais cette lettre comme un simple texte narratif sans en-tête ni formule d'appel : au BEPC, l'absence des éléments formels de la lettre (adresse, date, salutation, signature) fait perdre des points même si le contenu est bon.

### Conseil
Respecte strictement la fourchette de mots imposée (150-180 mots) : entraîne-toi à évaluer approximativement la longueur de tes paragraphes, une lettre trop courte ou trop longue peut être pénalisée par le barème de présentation.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Structure de la lettre personnelle en anglais

Chaque point demandé dans la consigne (ici : ton âge, ton avenir, ton choix d'époux/épouse) doit apparaître clairement, si possible dans des paragraphes séparés.

questions.enonce_markdown:
**Topic 2**

The national week of bilingualism was celebrated in your school and many activities were carried out. Say how it was done. In your essay you may:

- Say what bilingualism is,
- When is it celebrated in Cameroon,
- Activities that were carried out,
- Who the participants are,
- The importance of bilingualism to an individual, to Cameroon and to the whole world.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai narratif/descriptif organisé autour de plusieurs points imposés (ici cinq puces) doit traiter chaque point dans l'ordre proposé, avec un paragraphe d'introduction qui pose le sujet et un paragraphe de conclusion qui referme le texte, plutôt qu'une liste de réponses juxtaposées sans lien logique.

### Corrigé détaillé
**Modèle d'essai (environ 170 mots) :**

Bilingualism is the ability of a person or a country to use two languages, in our case English and French. In Cameroon, bilingualism week is celebrated every year at the end of February, and this year my school organised many activities to mark the event.

During the week, students performed sketches, poems and dances illustrating the ten regions of Cameroon, in line with the theme of the year. There was also a sketch on cultural integration and another on the protection of the environment, during which we were taught how to plant trees. All the students and teachers of the school took part, some as actors and others as the audience.

Bilingualism is very important. For an individual, it opens the door to more job opportunities and better communication. For Cameroon, it strengthens unity between English-speaking and French-speaking citizens. For the whole world, it encourages understanding between different cultures.

This is why every Cameroonian should be proud of learning both English and French.

### Piège à éviter
Ne te contente pas d'énumérer les activités sans les relier à la définition et à l'importance du bilinguisme demandées par le sujet : un essai qui ignore un des points de la consigne perd des points même si le reste est bien écrit.

### Conseil
Organise ton essai en autant de paragraphes que de grandes idées demandées par la consigne : cela rend ta copie plus lisible pour le correcteur et t'assure de ne rien oublier.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Organiser un essai autour de points imposés
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Un essai narratif/descriptif organisé autour de plusieurs points imposés (ici cinq puces) doit traiter chaque point dans l'ordre proposé, avec un paragraphe d'introduction qui pose le sujet et un paragraphe de conclusion qui referme le texte, plutôt qu'une liste de réponses juxtaposées sans lien logique.

questions.enonce_markdown:
**Topic 3**

You are a member of the health club in your school and you discover that your classmate is suffering from HIV/AIDS. He no longer comes to school because he is very sick and his family members and school mates have rejected him. Write a speech to be presented during the youth week celebration encouraging your mates to accept people living with the illness. In your speech, you should:

- Say what HIV/AIDS is,
- Give the different means of transmission, its symptoms and how it can be prevented,
- Talk about tolerance and acceptance in school,
- Suggest some of the things people living with the illness can do to avoid being stigmatised. Your name is OSONG Ako. Your school is GBHS Nkura and your post office box number is 215.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un discours (« speech ») a une structure propre, différente de l'essai ou de la lettre : une formule d'ouverture qui s'adresse directement au public (« Dear friends, Ladies and gentlemen... »), un corps qui développe les points imposés en s'adressant toujours à l'auditoire (usage fréquent de « you », de questions rhétoriques, de phrases d'encouragement), et une formule de clôture qui remercie le public et signe l'orateur.

### Corrigé détaillé
**Modèle de discours (environ 170 mots) :**

Dear friends and schoolmates,

I am OSONG Ako, a member of the health club of GBHS Nkura, and I am happy to speak to you today during our youth week celebration.

HIV/AIDS is a serious illness caused by a virus that attacks the body's immune system. It is transmitted through unprotected sex, contaminated blood, or from an infected mother to her child. A person living with HIV may show no symptoms for years, but without treatment, the illness weakens the body over time. It can be prevented by avoiding unprotected sex, using sterilised instruments, and going for regular testing.

Unfortunately, some of our schoolmates living with this illness are rejected by their own families and classmates. This is unfair, because HIV/AIDS is not transmitted through normal daily contact.

I therefore encourage all of us to show tolerance and to accept our classmates living with the illness. Those affected should keep taking their treatment regularly, join support groups, and continue their studies with confidence, because with proper care, they can live long and normal lives.

Thank you for listening.

### Piège à éviter
Ne rédige pas ce texte comme une simple lettre ou un essai impersonnel : un discours qui ne s'adresse jamais directement au public (absence de « dear friends », de « you », de remerciement final) est pénalisé pour non-respect du format imposé, même si les informations médicales sont exactes.

### Conseil
Termine toujours un discours par une formule de remerciement au public (« Thank you for listening », « Thank you for your attention ») : c'est un signal fort et attendu par les correcteurs qui montre que tu maîtrises ce type de production écrite.
